whats_new.title: Keep chats with your OS
whats_new.detail: You can turn on private chat saving in supported local Claude Code and Codex versions on Mac and Linux. Saved conversations remain in your OS folder when you move it or switch supported tools.

whats_new.title: Find original conversations
whats_new.detail: Ask in your own words, open the original saved message, and keep looking through older chats.

whats_new.title: Put chats in the right project
whats_new.detail: Review and approve a move between Personal and a project. Earlier message links keep working, and AI-Verse stops returning the chat from its old project.

whats_new.title: Review more of what AI-Verse remembers
whats_new.detail: AI-Verse can review older saved notes, notice lasting rules, and improve the words used to find memories later.

whats_new.title: Safer handling of outside instructions
whats_new.detail: Extra checks help stop instructions inside outside material and skills from being treated as your own requests.

whats_new.title: Updates include existing helpers
whats_new.detail: A normal update also refreshes helpers you already use, preserves their settings and leaves local edits alone. AI-Verse explains when another step is needed.

whats_new.title: A cleaner skills library
whats_new.detail: 59 well described skills replace 120. Overlapping, broken and rarely useful ones were removed or merged, and every skill now ships with AI-Verse instead of being downloaded from elsewhere.

whats_new.title: Your chats can find every skill
whats_new.detail: Claude and Codex now see every library skill in your OS folder, so they pick the right one when your request fits, without you naming it.

whats_new.title: New filmmaking skills
whats_new.detail: AI Realism writes finished Seedance prompts and Higgsfield Acting writes performances that feel alive. They work with the director, video director and still image skills as one chain.

whats_new.title: Skill notes per project
whats_new.detail: Each project can keep its own notes for a skill, such as its brand and offer for marketing. Marketing skills read the current project's notes.

whats_new.title: Make your own skills
whats_new.detail: Use /skill to make a new skill, bring one in or see how a skill is set up. /learn now follows the same standard.

whats_new.title: Old skill names still work
whats_new.detail: Retired skill names point to the skill that replaced them.
